messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your healthcare provider about severe pain, swelling, or skin changes.
These symptoms occur where the injection was given.
In rare cases, the injection has caused serious damage to the surrounding tissue.
The damage included tissue death (necrosis) and gangrene.
The damage has needed surgery to treat.
This is not a complete list of side effects.
Others may happen.
Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects.
You may report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Triplet: ["hydroxyzine", "has rare side effect", "gangrene"]

The relation 'has rare side effect' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may cause the rare or uncommon adverse effect specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
C. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
D. 'has side effect more likely in': The subject drug is more likely to cause the specified adverse effect or reaction in the population or group specified by the object entity.
E. 'related to': The subject drug is associated with the medical condition or disease specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
